scene_visible_facts: A post lantern burns at the end of the ferry slip.
Osric stands beside the post lantern.
scene_summary: A short timber slip meets the river. Osric, a lantern-tender, stands by the post lantern. He is an ordinary worker with no special charge.

topics.text: Osric keeps the lantern at the ferry slip lit.
